name: Ambodo: Ukukhulisa Ndawonye
subtitle: Ukuzola, ukulingana, ubufakazi
promo: Uhlelo olulodwa lwamakhaya womabili. I-ToneGuard igcina imilayezo izolile, ikhalenda lezingane linihlanganisa nonke, futhi yonke irekhodi igxiviziwe ilungele inkantolo.
short: Khulisa ndawonye ngokuzola: imilayezo egxiviziwe, ikhalenda elilodwa, ubufakazi.
body:
Amakhaya amabili. Iqembu elilodwa.

I-Ambodo igcina ukukhulisa izingane ndawonye kuzolile, kunobulungiswa futhi kusemarekhodini — kini nobabili, ohlelweni olulodwa lomndeni.

• Xoxa ngokuzola — i-ToneGuard ihlola yonke imilayezo ngaphambi kokuba ifike futhi iphakamise inguqulo enomusa. Umlayezo ngamunye ugxivizwe kowandulelayo, ngakho umlando awukwazi ukushintshwa buthule.
• Hlela ngobulungiswa — ikhalenda elilodwa lezingane enilibona ngendlela efanayo nobabili. 2-2-3, isonto nesonto ngokushintshana, 2-2-5-5 nokunye. Shintshanani izinsuku ngokuthepha kabili; akukho okushintshayo kuze nivumelane nobabili.
• Gcina ubufakazi — amarekhodi okunikezelana, izindleko enabelana ngazo nomlando wokushintshana, kukhishwa njenge-PDF elungele inkantolo enokuqinisekiswa kwesigxivizo.
• Yazi izingane — isikole, udokotela, ama-aleji nosayizi endaweni eyodwa enabelana ngayo.
• Vumelanisa yonke indawo — izinsuku zezingane ku-Apple noma ku-Google Calendar.

Mahhala: hlela isikhala somndeni wakho nephrofayela yengane eyodwa, isheduli yezingane namarekhodi okunikezelana.
Ambodo Family (uhlelo olulodwa lwabazali bobabili, ngenyanga noma ngonyaka): xhuma umzali okhulisa nawe ukuze nibe nemilayezo egxiviziwe, imicimbi enabelana ngayo nezicelo zokushintshana, wengeze zonke izingane zakho, amarekhodi e-PDF alungele inkantolo, izindleko nokukhokhelana, ukuvumelanisa ikhalenda nokubhala kabusha kwe-ToneGuard okungenamkhawulo. Ukuxolelwa imali kuyatholakala emindenini ekudingayo.
payApple: Inkokhelo ikhokhiswa ku-Apple Account yakho uma uqinisekisa. Okubhaliselwe kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphandle uma kukhanselwe okungenani amahora angu-24 ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi. Phatha noma ukhansele ezilungiselelweni ze-Apple Account yakho.
payPlay: Inkokhelo ikhokhiswa ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google Play. Okubhaliselwe kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo uze ukukhansele; phatha noma ukhansele noma nini ku-Google Play → Izinkokhelo nokubhaliselwe.
whatsNewApple: I-Ambodo manje ikhuluma ulimi lwakho: izilimi ezingu-75 ezilandela izilungiselelo zefoni yakho, nezinsuku nezimali ezibhalwe ngendlela ozibhala ngayo. Okunye okusha: hlela umndeni wakho kuqala, bese wenza i-akhawunti ekugcineni.
